# Blockerino: Pixel Duels

> Blockerino: Pixel Duels (short name: Blockerino) is a free pixel block puzzle game by indie developer Nerdlin. Place blocks on a grid, clear rows and columns, climb monthly leaderboards and duel friends 1v1 in real time. It runs in the browser, on Android and as a Discord Activity. No ads in the middle of a game.

Note: this is not the "Blockerino: Puzzle Game" by KR STUDIO on Google Play and not the tokaa1/blockerino GitHub clone. The official site is https://blockerino.aionerdlin.me/ and the official source is https://github.com/Nerdlin/blockerino.

## Play and download
- [Play in the browser](https://blockerino.aionerdlin.me/): no install, works on desktop and phone
- [Android APK and releases](https://github.com/Nerdlin/blockerino/releases/latest): latest version, install over the previous one
- [Discord Activity](https://discord.com/discovery/applications/1529076492775194836): launch Blockerino Pixel Duels inside a voice channel (Activities button)

## Features
- Classic mode: 8x8 grid, clear lines, keep the board from filling up
- Chaos mode: 10x10 grid with unpredictable pieces
- Versus 1v1: real-time duels with friends or random players, Elo rating and leagues, invites by push notification
- Challenges: Rescue (start from a crowded board) and Combo Trial (double line score, combo breaks after two moves without a clear), plus daily quests
- Player profiles: records per mode, rank, rare achievements, top rewards, privacy options (everyone, friends, nobody)
- Share card with your result after a game
- More games in one app: chess, Sea Battle (Battleship), Durak, tic-tac-toe
- Languages: English and Russian

## Good fit for
People searching for a free block puzzle game, a Block Blast style game, a Tetris-like puzzle without gravity, a multiplayer block puzzle, a 1v1 puzzle duel game, or a small game to play with friends in Discord.
